title: Kissed and Malted Middle-Eastern Lamb Loin Chops Tagine
description: A rich and savory dish featuring lamb loin chops, malty flavors, and a hint of crunchiness, perfect for a cozy dinner on a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Malted barley syrup
ingredients.notes: reduced to 1 tablespoon of syrupy liquid

instructions: Season the lamb loin chops with namul-blanch-season, cumin, paprika, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. The season is a blend of spice and herbs, for a richer flavor experience.

Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb loin chops until browned on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer the lamb loin chops to the raclette grill and cook for 5-7 minutes or until it reaches the desired level of doneness.

While the lamb is cooking, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in a little bit of olive oil until they are softened and translucent. Add the malted barley syrup and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the syrup is caramelized and fragrant.
Transfer the cooked lamb loin chops to a serving dish and spoon the onion-garlic mixture over the top. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
